name: 85207 · Mesa, AZ
findings: ZIP 85207 (Mesa) has 92 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85207 (Mesa) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 85207 (Mesa) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.text: 2 social and fraternal organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 9 would.
